profile.headline: Software engineer skilled across full SDLC, building modular, scalable apps. Hands-on with CV, multithreaded backends, FastAPI, WebSockets, and React/TypeScript for responsive real-time interfaces.
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Anthony Patterson holds a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering Physics from North Carolina A&T State University and a Master’s degree from Georgia Tech in Computational Science and Engineering with an interdisciplinary focus on Aerospace Systems Design. He has over five years of experience contributing to innovative projects within the Department of Defense.

He is a innovative and technically proficient Software Engineer with hands-on experience across the full software development lifecycle from  initial concept to deployment of scalable, maintainable applications. Skilled in designing modular systems, writing clean, efficient code, and implementing practical solutions to complex problems using a variety of programming languages and frameworks. Through personal projects, I’ve deepened my expertise in developing computer vision applications, multithreaded backends, and responsive web interfaces that leverage tools like FastAPI, WebSockets, and Typescript + React. These projects reflect my passion for building intelligent, real-time applications with an emphasis on performance, usability, and modern design principles.
